messages:
maria: Anyone seeing a spike of 502/504s to hosted-api right after the 09:40 deploy? Dashboards just lit up.
devon: yup, alerting hit ~09:42. 5xx rate up ~2.3x.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-021 - Hosted API 5xx spike. Paging oncall.
leo: I can repro a 502 on /v1/generate with a simple curl. getting 'upstream prematurely closed connection'.
maria: copy a curl?
leo: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
leo: response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
ash: (note: i'm on vacation but watching) any config flags flipped during the rollout?
ash: I see a traffic migration to gatekeeper-v2 for canary at 09:39 in deploy log.
devon: that was the gated rollout for token-routing feature. It should only affect 10% canary though.
ash: dashboard shows canary config somehow became global at 09:39:58 - rule eval returned true for all routes.
maria: oh no. which rule?
ash: gatekeeper.flag: "route_token_mode == \"rotate\" && rollout_pct >= 10" - looks like the route_token_mode default got set to "rotate" in the new image.
leo: rotate == token rotation mechanism that calls auth-service for every request (sync). If auth-service is slow, upstream will time out.
ash: auth-service got a token key rotation at 09:38 (ops-triggered) — latency spike in logs around 09:39.
ash: combination of cannier flipping to rotate + auth rotation = auth-service rabbit-hole.
ash: logs: 
```
auth-service 2026-02-15T09:39:02Z ERROR refresh_key: timeout (5000ms)
auth-proxy 2026-02-15T09:39:10Z WARN token-validate: queue-length=1200
proxy 2026-02-15T09:39:22Z ERROR upstream closed during headers
```
ash: so requests to hosted runtime are getting blocked waiting for token validation and then gateway times out.
leo: we should roll the flag back and restore gatekeeper to legacy token handling asap.
maria: agreed. who's owner for the rollout? deploy pipeline shows image=server:2026-02-15b and rollout id=rl-9821. devon, can you stop and rollback?
devon: starting rollback: triggering pipeline rollback to rl-9817 (pre-change).
devon: running: ./ci rollback --id rl-9821 --to rl-9817  (k8s rollout restart for gateway-proxy)
devon: note: traffic controller shows still routing 100% to v2 for some customers — suspect config propagation lag.
ash: i'm pushing a hotfix to gatekeeper config to set route_token_mode=legacy by default in configmap. will patch now.
ash: kubectl apply -f gatekeeper-configmap-patch.yaml

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gatekeeper-config
data:
  route_token_mode: "legacy"
```

ash: patched and reloaded gatekeeper.
sre-bot: Rollout event: gateway-proxy configmap updated by nash at 09:49.
leo: after patch, error rates dropped in canary region but still high overall.
maria: looks like some regions still pointing at old proxy instances that haven't picked up new config. need to restart proxies in us-west-2 fleet.
devon: restarting proxies in us-west-2: kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway-proxy -n hosted-us-west-2 --timeout=5m
ash: restarting.
support-bot: Customer alert: premium-account-123 reported degraded latency & 502s at 09:45. Ticket #C-8891 created.
maria: support team: please escalate C-8891 to enterprise ops and share temporary mitigation (client retry/backoff).
ash: mitigation: recommend clients set 2xx/5xx retry with exponential backoff, and avoid immediate token refresh during short windows. sending canned response to support.
ash: canned support reply: "We're investigating elevated 5xx responses originating from an authentication token rotation + canary config change. We're rolling back the canary and applying a config fix. Please implement retries at 500ms, 2s, 4s for now."
ash: added a temporary rate-limit on auth-service to slow down refresh storms.
leo: monitoring shows 5xx down to near-baseline at 09:58.
maria: good. postmortem todo: - why did gatekeeper default change? - why did canary flip to 100% for some routes? - why didn't config propagation cover all instances? - improve safety checks for token-rotation + canary interactions.
devon: i'll keep rl-9817 pinned until we have a tested gatekeeper image.
ash: also adding a canary guard that refuses to change route_token_mode for >5% traffic without manual approval.
maria: assign action owners and timeline in doc. I'll open INC-2026-021-POSTMORTEM and call a 10:30 blameless review.
sre-bot: Incident resolved: INC-2026-021 — degraded hosted-api 5xx spike mitigated and rollback applied. Resolution time: 00:18:59
maria: thanks everyone. please follow up on postmortem writeup and customer communications. :memo:
